Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
No worries — getting started with Nurosym is pretty simple. Here’s the easiest way to begin:
Put a small amount of moisture on the tragus (the small bump on your ear).
Clip the earpiece onto your left tragus, with the cable going over and behind your ear.
Turn the device on.
Slowly increase the energy until you feel a light, pleasant tingling sensation. 
Then just keep it on for 15–60 minutes per session while you read, work, relax, or do normal activities. Many people use it in the morning or split sessions between morning and evening. 
Tip: start with lower intensity and shorter sessions, then gradually adjust so the feeling stays comfortable. 
If you have any specific health conditions or are taking prescription medications, it’s a good idea to speak with our clinical team before starting.

Intensity (power level)
You slowly increase it until you feel a light tingling in your ear. That means it’s working. It should feel comfortable, not strong. 
Session length
Usually 15–60 minutes per session. You can read, work, or relax while using it. 
When to use it
Many people use it in the morning, evening, or split it into two shorter sessions. 
So basically:
👉 Put it on → turn it on → adjust to a gentle tingling → use it for 15–60 minutes.
That’s it — no complicated settings to learn at the start.
